sources.title: Space Skyboxes
sources.note: Correct author for this exact OpenGameArt URL is StumpyStrust, not Screaming Brain Studios. Published bkg.zip is about 122.3 MB; page-only, deliberately excluded from automatic bulk fetch.

sources.title: Skybox Pack
sources.note: Earlier page inspection reported CC0 and 22 files. A later fetch failed; exact package contents and current direct URL remain unresolved. Page-only.

sources.title: Qwantani Dusk 2 (Pure Sky)
sources.note: Sky-only photographic source. A web preview was visually inspected, not decoded locally or checked for cubemap seams. Choose a lower resolution through the page to avoid its large default HDR/EXR download.

sources.title: Kloppenheim 06 (Pure Sky)
sources.note: Sky-only source. Page describes warm rays and scattered cloud. Metadata-only curation; not a downloaded/converted atlas.

sources.title: Satara Night
sources.note: Visually inspected web image: bright village lights, huts and trees remain at the horizon. Not a pure sky. Reframe/edit before using as an isolated void backdrop.

sources.title: Moonlit Golf
sources.note: Not a pure sky: field and trees remain. Page publishes a tonemapped JPEG option; no local decode or seam review.
